author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.61 shipped: Safety hazards clear on recovery
why: Humidity/temperature/ROC hazards were raised but never cleared, so safety alert entities stayed on indefinitely and threshold-sitting readings flapped. Clear lines anchor to the lowest raise rung so CO/TVOC do not flap; life-safety raises during the hold re-run valve/lights/page so the hold can never mute a real event. Tier 2-DB, A/B SHIP, C fixed; 5 order-dependent tests fixed by resolving the live module.
implications: Shipped SAFETY-HAZARD-NEVER-CLEARS-1 at v5.103.61; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.61.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If an active hazard does not clear within ~6 min of its sensor recovering after restart, or any life-safety event fails to page during a hold.

refs.release_notes: Humidity, temperature and rate hazards now clear after recovery past a hysteresis line plus a 5-min hold; smoke/CO/leak re-raise during a pending clear re-runs the full response. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.61.md
